<module id="fsm">
    <description>Mealy FSM detection circuit that detects a single-bit input IN. When the input is 10011, output MATCH is 1, and MATCH is 0 in other cases. Support for continuous input and loop detection.</description>
    <ports>
        <input id="IN">Input signal to the FSM.</input>
        <input id="CLK">Clock signal used for synchronous operation.</input>
        <input id="RST">Reset signal to initialize the FSM.</input>
        <output id="MATCH">Output signal indicating a match condition based on the FSM state.</output>
    </ports>
    <parameter_description>
        <parameter id="S0">Initial state.</parameter>
        <parameter id="S1">State after detecting '1'.</parameter>
        <parameter id="S2">State after detecting '10'.</parameter>
        <parameter id="S3">State after detecting '100'.</parameter>
        <parameter id="S4">State after detecting '1001'.</parameter>
        <parameter id="S5">State after detecting '10011'.</parameter>
    </parameter_description>
    <logic_description type="sequential_logic">
        <reg id="current_state" width_description="[2:0]">Register to hold current state.</reg>
        <reg id="next_state" width_description="[2:0]">Register to hold next state.</reg>
        <always @(posedge CLK or negedge RST)>
            if (~RST) begin
                current_state <= S0;
            end else begin
                current_state <= next_state;
            end
        </always>
    </logic_description>
    <logic_description type="combinational_logic">
        <assign id="MATCH">Output signal indicating a match condition based on the FSM state.</assign>
        <always @(*) begin
            case(current_state)
                S0: begin
                    if(IN == 1'b1) begin
                        next_state = S1;
                        MATCH = 1'b0;
                    end else begin
                        next_state = S0;
                        MATCH = 1'b0;
                    end
                end
                S1: begin
                    if(IN == 1'b0) begin
                        next_state = S2;
                        MATCH = 1'b0;
                    end else begin
                        next_state = S1;
                        MATCH = 1'b0;
                    end
                end
                S2: begin
                    if(IN == 1'b0) begin
                        next_state = S3;
                        MATCH = 1'b0;
                    end else begin
                        next_state = S1;
                        MATCH = 1'b0;
                    end
                end
                S3: begin
                    if(IN == 1'b1) begin
                        next_state = S4;
                        MATCH = 1'b0;
                    end else begin
                        next_state = S0;
                        MATCH = 1'b0;
                    end
                end
                S4: begin
                    if(IN == 1'b1) begin
                        next_state = S5;
                        MATCH = 1'b0;
                    end else begin
                        next_state = S0;
                        MATCH = 1'b0;
                    end
                end
                S5: begin
                    if(IN == 1'b1) begin
                        next_state = S1;
                        MATCH = 1'b1;
                    end else begin
                        next_state = S0;
                        MATCH = 1'b0;
                    end
                end
                default: begin
                    next_state = S0;
                    MATCH = 1'b0;
                end
            endcase
        end
    </logic_description>
</module>
